# Nibly

> Nibly is the digital vending brand of Cypress Vending Corp., based in North Vancouver, British Columbia. It offers touchscreen vending machines for buyers and a separate workplace hosting program.

Nibly machines feature a 48-inch touchscreen, cashless payments, remote inventory tracking and real-time sales monitoring. An optional smart locker accommodates products that do not fit standard vending coils. See The Machine for dimensions, capacity and configuration details.

Buyers can enquire about Silver, Gold and Platinum packages, start-up guidance and location advice. Workplace hosts can enquire about having a stocked Nibly machine placed at their location. Buying a machine and hosting one are different arrangements. Confirm pricing, package inclusions, location availability and service responsibilities directly with the team.

Contact: sales@cypressvending.ca or +1 604 638 6078. Office: #204-370 Esplanade East, North Vancouver, BC V7L 1A4, Canada.

The main sales enquiry forms connect to HubSpot. The separate service request form is not yet accepting submissions; use the published email address or telephone number for assistance. The site has no shopping cart, online checkout or PayPal donation functionality.

- [Home](index.html): Nibly's company identity, smart vending features, and the distinction between buying and workplace hosting.
- [The Machine](the-machine.html): Touchscreen vending machine and optional locker specifications, package enquiries, costs to discuss, location advice, support questions and FAQs.
- [Locations](locations.html): Workplace hosting, stocked machine placement, restocking and how to enquire about availability at a particular location.
- [Contact Us](contact-us.html): Cypress Vending Corp. attribution, office address, email and telephone details for machine, hosting and support enquiries.
